name: Émile Dining Table
description: A dining table blending timeless materials with modern wood marquetry, for contemporary and mid-century interiors.
lede: A dining table drawn in long bands of veneer: palissander, ash root and black wengue, set off by fine lines of white oak and finished in high-gloss lacquer. Two banded pedestals carry a top that seats eight to ten.

story.title: Stripes that run from top to floor
story.text: The bands of the top continue down each cylindrical pedestal, so the table reads as one continuous piece of marquetry from every side. Every strip is cut and matched by hand, then sealed under several coats of lacquer for a deep, mirror-like surface.

ambience.alt: Émile Dining Table in a dining room with sculpted wooden stools and a striped rug
Émile Dining Table with wooden stools, side view
Close-up of the Émile table edge and banded pedestal
Corner of the Émile top showing ash root and palissander bands

name: Alba Cabinet
description: A storage cabinet with a striped facade of light and dark wood veneers, three doors and six drawers.
lede: Alternating bands of gloss sucupira and pale sycamore run across three doors and six drawers, shifting rhythm where the drawers begin. The cabinet floats on a recessed plinth, with glass shelves and a bird's-eye interior behind the doors.

story.title: A facade that changes its beat
story.text: The stripes on the doors are long and calm; on the drawers below they break into shorter blocks, so the pattern reads like a bar of music. Open the doors and the warm bird's-eye interior and glass shelves turn the cabinet into a display piece for glassware, books or a bar.

ambience.alt: Alba Cabinet against a green plaster wall between two globe floor lamps

name: Cadogan Sideboard
description: A mid-century modern wood sideboard with four discreet drawers and a playful, sculptural look.
lede: A long, rounded gloss top in sucupira sits on a row of sculpted columns, its band patched with walnut root, olive, cherry and pau ferro. Four discreet drawers hide in the patchwork and open onto a natural bird's-eye interior.

story.title: Solid shapes, set in motion
story.text: Seen from the front, the base reads like a row of organ pipes, with pale olive ovals carved into the darker burr. The patchwork band hides four drawers so well that the sideboard looks like a single sculpted block until you open it. It is made for an entryway or a mid-century dining room that wants one memorable piece.

ambience.alt: Cadogan Sideboard against a concrete wall beneath a round black mirror, drawers slightly open

name: Dunn Bench
description: A cherry-veneer bench with a cream velvet seat, suited to entryways or dining rooms.
lede: A long seat of cream velvet rests on a single cherry plinth, with a faceted backrest that folds in shallow angles like a paper screen. Every surface is cherry veneer in a high-gloss finish.

story.title: A classic bench, folded
story.text: The backrest is cut into angled planes, so the grain of the cherry catches the light differently on each face. It floats on a central post above a deep velvet cushion, which makes the bench feel lighter than its size. It is at home in an entrance hall, along a dining table or at the foot of a bed.

name: Hastings Desk
description: An oval wooden desk with a modern twist on marquetry and a vintage-inspired, timeless look.
lede: An oval top in gloss black bird's-eye rests on two rounded pedestals, banded and inlaid with natural bird's-eye in blocks of gold. Curved doors open onto shelves and a pivoting drawer, all lined in warm bird's-eye.
materials: Natural bird's-eye veneer, inlay and interior

story.title: Lacquer black, inlaid with light
story.text: The pale inlays are set like brass plates against the black, running around the edge of the top and across the pedestals in long and short bars. Behind the curved doors are rounded shelves and a drawer that swings out on a pivot, so the desk keeps its clean outline when closed. It suits a study, a private office or a reception room.

ambience.alt: Hastings Desk in a panelled study with a brass desk lamp
Hastings Desk in a panelled salon beneath a crystal chandelier

name: Stuart Wall Decor
description: A geometric wall panel built from marquetry in several wood tones, arranged to create depth.
lede: A tall oval panel assembled from quarter circles and squares of sucupira, walnut, pau ferro and olive, set against cream. The pieces sit at slightly different depths, so the composition shifts as you walk past it.

story.title: Marquetry, hung like a painting
story.text: Each section is cut and laid by hand, with fine gaps between the pieces that add shadow and depth. Light and dark woods turn around the centre like the curve of a letter, so the panel reads as a single gesture from across the room. It is made to anchor an entrance hall or the main wall of a living room.

name: Helix Mirror
description: A wall mirror with a sunburst-style frame of layered wood veneers, a sculptural focal point.
lede: A round mirror framed by a sunburst of marquetry rays in gloss pau ferro, white bird's-eye, black tulipwood and ash root. The points step forward from the wall, so every ray catches the light at its own angle.
materials: Pau ferro wood veneer, gloss marquetry

story.title: A sunburst in four woods
story.text: Light, dark and pale veneers alternate around the glass like the rays of a compass rose, with scalloped black points between them. The raised pau ferro ring holds the mirror like a lens. It makes an entrance hall, a living room or a bedroom wall feel finished on its own.

ambience.alt: Helix Mirror above a black console in a plaster-walled hallway

name: Zola Wall Decor
description: A handcrafted wood wall panel with flowing, nature-inspired curves and geometric lines.

name: Ruby Wall Decor
description: A handcrafted wooden wall piece with lively, irregular forms that add movement to a room.

name: Kent Sideboard
description: An Art Deco-inspired sideboard with black marquetry doors and a white maple interior.
lede: Four marquetry fronts set a pale circle inside each square, framed alternately by black-and-white stripes and walnut root. The fronts step in and out along the length, opening onto shelves and drawers in gloss white maple.

story.title: Circles, stripes and burl
story.text: The pattern borrows from Art Deco graphics: a black ring around each circle, stripes that run up or down depending on the panel, and warm walnut root to break the rhythm. Behind the doors are adjustable shelves, and one end hides a stack of four drawers. At 240 cm it anchors a dining room, a living room or a long hallway.

ambience.alt: Kent Sideboard against a curved oak wall beneath an abstract artwork

name: Savile Mirror
description: A circular mirror pairing warm wood marquetry with a soft white lacquered finish.
lede: A wide round frame laid in segments of gloss walnut, walnut root, cherry root and pau ferro, broken by two sweeps of white bird's-eye. A bevelled mirror sits deep in the centre.

story.title: Tailored in five woods
story.text: Each segment of the frame is cut to a different angle, so the pale bird's-eye and the dark roots seem to turn around the glass. The high-gloss finish reflects the room back into the wood itself. It hangs well above a sideboard or a console, or alone as the focal point of a wall.

name: Morris Mirror
description: An oval wall mirror with a warm wooden frame inlaid with a geometric marquetry pattern.
lede: A deep oval frame in gloss pau ferro marquetry, crossed by diagonal bands of walnut root, olive and sucupira. The bands meet in chevrons around the glass, so the frame seems to turn as the light moves.
materials: Pau ferro wood veneer, gloss marquetry

story.title: An oval, set in motion
story.text: Light olive and dark walnut root alternate in angled strips, a pattern that reads almost like woven cane from across a room. The frame stands 12 cm from the wall, which gives it real presence above a console or a sideboard. Hung alone, it becomes the focal point of an entrance hall or living room.

ambience.alt: Morris Mirror above a sculptural console against a white plaster wall
Morris Mirror in an arched plaster hallway

name: Cora Mirror
description: A round wood wall mirror with a geometric marquetry pattern and mid-century styling.

name: Jacques Totem
description: A mid-century modern totem with geometric wood marquetry in black, white and ash.
lede: A tall square column, 180 cm high, laid in a playful geometric marquetry of gloss black bird's-eye, white bird's-eye and ash root.

story.title: A column of light and dark
story.text: Blocks of black and pale bird's-eye shift from one face to the next, with warm ash root to break the rhythm, so the pattern changes as you walk around it. It stands on its own like a sculpture and holds a corner of a living room, a hallway or a hotel lobby.

name: Kuching Totem
description: An abstract wood marquetry piece in black and dark orange, combining shapes of different sizes.
lede: A stack of blocks and rounded forms, 180 cm high, in matte black lacquer and warm cherry. Abstract figures and a single watchful eye are inlaid in black bird's-eye and white maple across the faces.

story.title: A totem of shapes
story.text: Each block is a different size and turns at a slightly different angle, so the column reads like a stacked sculpture. The inlaid drawings, a face at the top and an eye at the base, take their cue from carved posts in Pacific island architecture. Placed in a corner or a hallway, it turns the room into something closer to a gallery.

name: Tāhuna Totem
description: A tall geometric piece in black gloss and white bird's-eye wood marquetry.
lede: A slender column in gloss black bird's-eye rises from a pale white bird's-eye base. Flowing figures and watchful eyes are inlaid across both, black on cream below and cream on black above.

story.title: Figures that wrap the corners
story.text: The inlaid drawing runs straight across the edges of the column, so a figure that starts on one face finishes on the next. The base reverses the palette, a dark face with two eyes set into pale veneer. At 160 cm it stands like a small sculpture in a living room, a dining room or an entrance.

name: Gris Center Table
description: A coffee table with a bird's-eye marquetry top and glossy black lacquered legs, inspired by Cubism.
lede: A round low table with a gloss black bird's-eye top inlaid with a cubist drawing in white bird's-eye. The striped edge and fluted black lacquered legs frame the composition.

story.title: A still life seen from above
story.text: The top reads like a cubist canvas laid flat: faces, a guitar and a bottle broken into planes of cream veneer on black. Early twentieth century Cubism is the reference, cut by hand in contrasting bird's-eye. At 100 cm across and 50 cm high it anchors a seating group and is made to order.

ambience.alt: Gris Center Table between two pink armchairs in a sunlit living room
Gris Center Table with books beside a hoop chair

name: Jean-Jacques Room Divider
description: A four-panel folding screen that alternates gloss black lacquer with abstract marquetry in burr woods.
lede: Four panels of different heights fold into a sculptural screen. Gloss black lacquered leaves alternate with marquetry panels, where loose organic shapes in walnut root, ash root, bird's-eye and white maple meet across the joints.
materials: Black, grey and natural bird's-eye veneers

story.title: A collage in wood
story.text: The marquetry is composed like a cut-paper collage, with warm burrs, pale maple and black bird's-eye set against each other in irregular forms. Stepped silhouettes and cut-out windows let light and the room through, so the screen divides a space without closing it. At 300 cm wide and 200 cm high it suits a living room, a study or a bedroom, and it is made to order.

ambience.alt: Jean-Jacques Room Divider against a timber wall between two sand-coloured armchairs

name: Charlotte Totem
description: An obelisk-like piece covered in black wood marquetry patterns.
lede: Three stacked volumes form a modern obelisk. Two blocks in natural bird's-eye carry bold black marquetry drawings, and a matte black lacquered column sits between them.

story.title: A drawing that turns the corner
story.text: The black marquetry reads like an ancient sign, an eye and a reaching figure cut into pale bird's-eye. Each drawing wraps from one face to the next, so the piece changes as you walk around it. At 180 cm tall it holds an entrance hall or the corner of a living room on its own, and it is made to order.

name: Bernard Totem
description: A handmade decorative column with striking monochrome geometric marquetry.
lede: Five blocks of different sizes are stacked into a playful column. Panels of white bird's-eye carry bold black marquetry faces and signs, set between gloss black lacquered sections and a curved black base.

story.title: Faces in black and white
story.text: Each block carries its own part of the drawing: eyes, a mouth, stripes and small signs cut in black and pale bird's-eye. Seen from the side, the faces break apart into pure graphic shapes. At 160 cm tall it works as a centrepiece in a minimal entrance or as an accent in a living room, and it is made to order.

name: Prisme Side Table
description: A faceted side table in white tulipwood marquetry with figures inlaid in deep blue.
lede: A faceted volume of triangular planes, veneered in white tulipwood laid in chevrons. Blue tulipwood figures run, leap and stretch across every face, cut in a single strong colour.

story.title: Figures in a single blue
story.text: The deep blue recalls Yves Klein and his search for a colour that stands on its own. Each figure is cut in blue tulipwood and set into white, and the drawing crosses the folds of the prism so it changes with every step around it. At 60 cm wide and 45 cm high it sits beside a sofa or reading chair, and it is made to order.

ambience.alt: Prisme Side Table on a pale rug beside white bookshelves and a slatted lounge chair

name: Sanogo Bedside Table
description: A round, three-legged bedside table with marquetry in black, white and ash wood.
lede: A round bedside table on three legs, veneered in golden ash root with bands of white tulipwood and gloss black bird's-eye. Its top is inlaid with black and pale signs, faces and patterns, and a curved drawer follows the line of the body.

story.title: Signs from many places
story.text: The drawing on the top borrows from twentieth-century folk motifs and pop imagery, cut in black and pale veneers on warm ash root. Vertical stripes carry the pattern down the sides and legs. At 55 cm across and 50 cm high it sits beside a bed or an armchair, and it is made to order.

name: Kelly Sideboard
description: An angular sideboard in gloss black wenge ash with striped bird's-eye marquetry doors and a polished gold disc.
lede: A long, angular body in gloss black wenge ash opens out into faceted wings. Its doors carry diagonal stripes of black and natural bird's-eye, and a polished gold disc sits where the two central doors meet.
materials: Black and natural bird's-eye veneers, gloss marquetry
Interior in gloss black wenge ash with an aged mirror back

story.title: Mid-century at first glance
story.text: The proportions recall the mid-century sideboard, but the faceted ends and the striped doors belong to Art Deco. Inside, the aged mirror back catches the light when the doors open. At 160 cm wide and 85 cm high it anchors a dining room or a living room, and it is made to order.

name: Catalonia Center Table
description: A center table with mid-century lines and a marquetry top in walnut root, bird's eye and ash root.
lede: A round low table with a top of walnut root inlaid with playful shapes in ash root and black, white and grey bird's-eye. A striped edge of black and pale bird's-eye wraps the top, which rests on fluted legs in gloss black lacquer.
materials: Black, white and grey bird's-eye veneers

story.title: Signs, shapes and objects
story.text: The top is a field of pictorial signs, biomorphic forms and abstract objects, scattered across warm walnut root like a mid-century painting. The striped edge and fluted legs keep the outline simple, so the drawing does the talking. At 100 cm across and 50 cm high it anchors a seating group, and it is made to order.

name: Blue Star Side Table
description: A side table with a marquetry top in a playful, Dada-inspired geometric pattern.
lede: A round side table on three curved legs, veneered in white bird's-eye with bands of black. Its top carries a bold face-like drawing in blue tulipwood, outlined in black, with eyes in red tulipwood and ash root.

story.title: A Dada game on the tabletop
story.text: The drawing on the top plays like a Dada collage: a blue field, a thick black line and two watching eyes. The black bands continue down the legs, so the pattern reads from every side. At 55 cm across and 51 cm high it sits beside a sofa or armchair, and it is made to order.

name: Stocletfrieze Side Table
description: A round three-legged side table in a mosaic of white tulipwood, black bird's-eye, ash root and cherry root.
lede: A round side table on three curved legs. Its top is a mosaic of white tulipwood, golden ash root and warm cherry root, divided by sweeping lines of black bird's-eye that continue down the legs.

story.title: A frieze in wood
story.text: The name nods to the Viennese Secession and its great mosaic friezes, where gold, black and ivory were set side by side. Here the same idea is cut in veneer: pale and warm woods held together by black lines, and the pattern runs from the top onto each leg. At 55 cm across and 51 cm high it sits beside a sofa or armchair, and the wood tones can be tailored. It is made to order.

ambience.alt: Stocletfrieze Side Table on a yellow and grey rug beside a cream armchair and a stepped wooden lamp

name: Tuxedo Bedside Table
description: A black bedside table with three drawers, marquetry detailing and sphere-style legs.
lede: Three drawers in gloss black bird's-eye are stacked slightly off-centre and rest on beige lacquered spheres. Eyes, crowns and dashes in white tulipwood and grey bird's-eye run across the fronts.

story.title: Black tie, with a wink
story.text: Like a dinner jacket, it is mostly black and very polished, with a few pale details that catch the eye. The signs draw on twentieth-century folk motifs and pop imagery, and each drawer shifts a little so the drawing breaks and meets again. At 57 cm wide and 60 cm high it sits beside a bed or a sofa, and it is made to order.

name: Crown Center Table
description: A three-legged table with a marquetry top drawing on multicultural motifs and pop imagery.
lede: A round low table with a top of warm cherry root, covered in signs, faces, eyes and crowns inlaid in black bird's-eye and white tulipwood. A striped edge of cherry root and black wraps the top, which stands on fluted gloss black legs.

story.title: A crowd of signs
story.text: The top is filled edge to edge with small drawings: crowns, eyes, mouths, hands and zigzags borrowed from twentieth-century folk motifs and pop imagery. Each sign is cut by hand in black or pale veneer and set into cherry root. At 100 cm across and 50 cm high it anchors a seating group, and it is made to order.

name: Kubo Bedside Table
description: A cubist-inspired nightstand on wooden-sphere legs, white bird's-eye body with grey marquetry.
lede: Three drawers in gloss white bird's-eye are stacked slightly off-centre and rest on cream lacquered spheres. A cubist drawing in grey bird's-eye, all lines, eyes and broken faces, runs across the fronts.

story.title: Cubism in pale tones
story.text: The drawing follows Picasso and the Cubists: faces split into lines and planes, here cut in soft grey against white. Each drawer is offset, so the image shifts as the drawers move. At 57 cm wide and 60 cm high it suits a calm, minimal bedroom as much as a bolder one, and it is made to order.

name: Maple Side Table
description: A compact round marquetry side table inlaid in black and natural bird's-eye veneer.
lede: A round side table on three curved legs in gloss black bird's-eye, banded with natural bird's-eye. Across the top, figures in natural bird's-eye leap and tumble over a black ground.

story.title: Figures in motion
story.text: The top recalls Yves Klein's experiments, where bodies left their trace on the canvas. Here the figures are cut in warm bird's-eye and scattered across black, and the stripes carry the same two woods down each leg. At 55 cm across and 51 cm high it sits beside a sofa or armchair, and it is made to order.

name: Folk Prisma Side Table
description: A cube-shaped marquetry side table in black, white and cherry-root wood.

name: Maple Bedside Table
description: A three-drawer nightstand on spherical wooden legs, in black and natural bird's-eye marquetry.
lede: Three drawers in gloss black bird's-eye are stacked slightly off-centre and rest on ochre lacquered spheres. Figures in natural bird's-eye leap across the fronts, matching the Maple Side Table.

story.title: A companion to the Maple Side Table
story.text: The same leaping figures as the Maple Side Table, inspired by Yves Klein's body prints, run across three offset drawers. As the drawers open, the figures break apart and meet again. At 57 cm wide and 60 cm high it sits beside a bed in a modern or maximalist bedroom, and it is made to order.

name: Chrysler Dining Table
description: An oval ivory dining table on two contrasting pedestals, with a bird's-eye top and polished gold details.
lede: A long oval top in bird's-eye veneer, lacquered ivory and set with polished gold discs, rests on two different pedestals: a fluted ivory column on a black base, and a striped sphere on a black cone. A black and gold band runs around the edge.

story.title: Two pedestals, one table
story.text: The two bases never match: one is a classical fluted column, the other a striped sphere balanced on a cone. It is a playful idea borrowed from 1980s Memphis design, refined with ivory lacquer and polished gold. At 280 cm long it seats eight to ten in a formal dining room, and it can be customised. It is made to order.

ambience.alt: Chrysler Dining Table with green armchairs under a gold ribbon chandelier
Close view of the striped sphere pedestal and gold inlaid top with green armchairs

name: Ferrá Side Table
description: A faceted side table in gloss black bird's-eye with playful shapes in red tulipwood, pear, ash root and white bird's-eye.
lede: A faceted, prism-like body in gloss black bird's-eye, scattered with organic shapes: coral-like branches in red tulipwood, blobs of pear and ash root, and pale curls of white bird's-eye.

story.title: A game of shapes on black
story.text: The pattern plays like a Dada or Surrealist sketchbook: shapes float freely across the black ground and cross the folds of the prism, so every side tells a different story. At 60 cm wide and 45 cm high it works as a side table or a sculptural accent in a living room, and it is made to order.

name: Malaga Center Table
description: A coffee table with a cubist-inspired top in white and black bird's-eye on three beige lacquer legs.

name: Bodún Bedside Table
description: A handmade nightstand with a Picasso-inspired marquetry pattern and sphere-shaped legs.
lede: Three drawers stacked slightly off-centre and set on gloss black lacquered spheres. A cubist drawing in black bird's-eye on grey bird's-eye runs across the fronts.

story.title: Cubism in grey and black
story.text: The marquetry takes its cue from Picasso: faces and objects broken into lines and planes, cut in black against soft grey bird's-eye. Each drawer is offset, so the drawing shifts as the drawers move. At 57 cm wide and 60 cm high it suits a minimal or mid-century bedroom, and it is made to order.

ambience.alt: Bodún Bedside Table under a single spotlight with its drawers slightly open

name: Fernand Side Table
description: A faceted side table in gloss black bird's-eye with a cubist drawing in white bird's-eye.
lede: A faceted, prism-like body in gloss black bird's-eye, covered on every face with a drawing in white bird's-eye. Lines, eyes and fragments of faces run across the folds of the volume.

story.title: Cubism wrapped around a prism
story.text: The drawing takes its cue from Picasso and the Cubists: faces broken into lines and planes, then cut in pale veneer against black. Because the table itself is faceted, the image breaks again at every edge. At 60 cm wide and 45 cm high it sits beside a sofa or armchair, and it is made to order.

name: Harlequin Side Table
description: A faceted side table in mixed-wood marquetry, with diamonds of ash, pear and red, blue and white tulipwood.
lede: A faceted, prism-like volume dressed in diamonds and triangles of veneer. Pale ash and white tulipwood meet warm pear, red and blue tulipwood and black bird's-eye, so every face shows a different composition.

story.title: Pure forms, played with light
story.text: The pattern follows Kazimir Malevich and his pure geometric forms. Each facet is cut and coloured so that light and shade build a sense of perspective, like a harlequin's diamonds folding around the body. At 60 cm wide and 45 cm high it works as a side table or as a sculptural accent, and it is made to order.

name: Georges Bedside Table
description: A nightstand on three slim legs with a marquetry top of Picasso-inspired cubist figures.
lede: A round bedside table on three curved legs, laid in gloss white bird's-eye with inlaid black bird's-eye. The top carries a drawing of cubist faces and figures, and fine black stripes run down the drum and legs.

story.title: A cubist sketch, in wood
story.text: The top reads like a page from an artist's notebook, with eyes, profiles and hatched lines cut from black bird's-eye and set into the pale veneer. A single curved drawer is hidden in the drum, its edges traced by the stripes. It brings a touch of the studio to a bedroom, a reading corner or a guest suite.

name: Gustav Center Table
description: A coffee table inlaid in toulipier, black bird's eye, ash root and cherry root.
lede: A low, round table whose top and sides form one continuous mosaic of pale tulipwood, golden ash root and deep cherry root, divided by bold lines of black bird's-eye. Three wide legs carry the pattern down to the floor.

story.title: A Viennese mosaic
story.text: Named for the Viennese painter of gold and pattern, the table treats wood like a mosaic: warm and pale pieces held together by black lines, running over the edge and down each leg. Low and generous at 120 cm across and 30 cm high, it anchors a living room, and it is made to order.

ambience.alt: Gustav Center Table on a striped rug in front of a cream sofa

name: Zimmer Dining Table
description: A contemporary table on black-lacquered legs with an inlaid top of mixed wood veneers.

name: Claire Dressing Table
description: An Art Deco-inspired dressing table with rounded, lavish forms for the master bedroom.

name: Ludwika Side Table
description: A marquetry side table inspired by Kazimir Malevich's geometric style.

name: Rapple Console Table
description: A 1920s-inspired console with a glossy black top, gold-toned trim and bird's-eye finishes.

name: Annali Console Table
description: A glossy terra brown and ivory drawer console with an Art Deco look.

name: Rumba Console Table
description: A console with marquetry tops and playful motifs that bring energy to an entryway.

name: Matrioska Bedside Table
description: A geometric nightstand in walnut and bird's-eye marquetry with gold steel and black lacquer.

name: Charlot Console Table
description: An Art Deco-inspired entrance console with a marble top and marquetry panels.

name: Luminous Wood Floor Lamp
description: A 1930s-style turned-wood lamp in walnut and wenge with gold details and a white glass globe.

name: Austria Bedside Table
description: A marquetry nightstand with a gloss white interior, in customisable wood finishes.
